g.title: Embeds the query once with the search_query prefix, then asks the vector store and the BM25 index for 20 candidates each.
query.rs merges the two ranked lists with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, keyed by file and start line, and prints the top five chunks with file, line range and code.

walker.rs honours .gitignore, keeps supported file types and skips lockfiles. delta.rs hashes every file and compares hash and mtime with the cache, so only new or changed files continue and deleted ones are purged.

chunker.rs parses Rust, Go, Python, TypeScript, Java and C/C++ into whole declarations. Over 3,000 non-whitespace characters, a node is split along its children and re-merged. Markdown splits at headings, config files at the size limit.

embedder.rs runs nomic-embed-text v1.5 INT8 through ort with Hugging Face tokenizers. Chunks are sorted by length, batched eight at a time, padded to a power of two, mean-pooled and L2-normalised into 768 dimensions.
A bincode list of path, SHA-256 and modification time per file. It is saved at the end of an index run, and files that failed to index are dropped from it so they are retried next time.

store.rs keeps an append-only record log with tombstones, compacted when dead records outnumber live ones. hnsw.rs builds a graph snapshot (vectors.hnsw) at 1,000 records or more. A stale or inconsistent snapshot falls back to an exact scan.
bm25.rs stores chunk text with its path and line range in a Tantivy index. Queries use the lenient parser, so code-shaped input such as foo::bar() never fails to parse.
